dataset.description: This dataset describes the synthesis of Hajos-Parrish ketone from commercially availabe 2-methylcyclopentane-1,3-dione and methyl vinyl ketone via Michael addition, enantioselective aldol addition and dehydration. NMR spectra of intermediates and products are attached.

distribution.title: The purpose of this data is to organize the synthetic procedures and characterization in one file.

dataset.title: Synthesis of Hajos–Parrish Ketone, a Key Building Block Towards The Synthesis of Libiguin A and Its Analogues

dmp.description: DMP describes the synthesis of key intermediates et route to Libiguin A.

project.description:
Phragmalin-type natural products are typified by the octahydro-1H-2,4-methanoindene cage
present in their carbon skeleton. The most prominent representative of this class of compounds is
libiguin A, currently in phase II clinical trials for the treatment of erectile dysfunction. Despite the
pharmacological relevance of phragmalin-type natural products, none of the representatives has
been achieved by total synthesis. The aim of this project is the development of total synthesis
route to access phragmalin-type compounds including the libiguin A and its analogues. To achieve
the aim, a synthesis strategy has been developed building on our previous work on construction of
methanoindene cage. The successful synthetic approach to libiguin A would provide an access to
its analogues enabling the investigation of their pharmacological effects.
